title: CoreX
description: Advanced Essentials Plugin for Modern Paper/Spigot Servers
body:
CoreX is an advanced all-in-one Minecraft utility plugin for Spigot servers featuring teleport systems, combat tagging, cooldown management, staff tools, join/quit customization, advertisements, and more.

## Features:

✔ Teleport Warmups

✔ Fly Management

✔ First Join Titles

✔ TPA & TPHere

✔ Custom Join/Quit Messages

✔ Automatic Advertisements

✔ Warps System

✔ Staff Chat

## Commands Included:

/spawn

/warp

/tpa

/tphere

/back

/fly

/staffchat

/commandspy
